settings.about_text: We work with all levels of distribution-- from training at tech schools and unions, to interacting with contractors to educate their techs, and supporting our wholesale distribution partners-- to calling on specifying engineers and even OEMs at times. Education is key. Education for ourselves and all involved in the process of manufacturing and distribution. We have offices in St. Louis, MO, Shawnee, KS and Des Moines, IA. Halfpenny Sales has been in business since 1980.
settings.product_text: Halfpenny Sales represenst a wide variety of product lines including HVAC equipment, indoor air quality, refrigeration and plumbing lines. Please contact Halfpenny Sales for specific inquiries.
